## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`, `perf:`, `test:`, `ci:`, `build:`, `chore:`, `style:`, `revert:`)
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` passes
- [ ] `cargo test --all-features` passes
- [ ] New behavior is covered by a script test in `tests/scripts/` (`<name>.jsq` + `<name>.out`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]`, or the `no-changelog` label is applied
- [ ] `docs/LANGUAGE.md` is updated if language behavior changed
- [ ] No comments were added to the code
